about: What each commit of this hour changed: its message beyond the subject, its session (the Claude-Session trailer), and its files with lines added and removed (git numstat; at most 40 files a commit). Written by tools/agents-commits.mjs. The list of commits: data/agents/commits.json.

5b345184939f7cf4a2e3d0645da7f4b8072a76b5.body:
New story stories/mainland-warned-against-observed: IPMA's red rain in eight
districts, the 07:16:30 wind change (red wind left only for Faro), the orange
sea; the airport and station hours inside the windows; occurrences, floods,
cars at Oriente, the bridge limit and 222 flights as evidence (rows
s-1111T0437 to s-1111T1037); our comparison. The generator names the mainland
districts in the warning box. Key incident-stories-dinis-5 added (public half),
-4 handed over; status and HANDOVER.md for the fifth session.

b8f2521909d2c98582125f1f4737a6c974cecf32.body: data/keys.json: incident-media-dinis-3 (public halves only) is active, incident-media-dinis-2 handed over. Wake at 10:52 UTC: 345 press items (5 new), coverage.json 174 KB of 256. live.mjs reads DN's live page of 11 November (11 timed entries). facts.json gains `not_matches`: entries read by hand that do not report a fact are never matched again. DN's lead entry of 08:11:27 carries the headline of its 09:14:37 entry (rewritten later, dateModified 10:46) and would have made DN first on fact 12; Observador's 08:46:16 stays first, DN is fourth at 118 minutes. No new IPMA message after 07:16:30, so no new keyed fact. Ledger line appended.

abaed1f0196227d9057c8f2ebce156bfe72b3076.body: To the keeper of tools/graph-build.mjs: please read the media items from the files in research/media/coverage.json's articles_files (join each file's articles) instead of its articles. The short rows kept there for you stop fitting under 256 KB at about 500 items (344 now, about 25 more an hour).

a08773322fee76160986d67e4e88c54043709059.body:
Dinis ~10:32 (no agent stops until its hand-over is done: a four-part test of
"done") and ~10:38 (one operator, no outside joining; D10 answered) built in.
transition/wakes.md: every wake from the conductor's 10:36 reading, keep /
retire / move; the four old ones retire at once. transition/README.md: a plain
index. Transport and broadcast rows filled.

6c003548587fe29530f07817de709788716473eb.body: OpenSky Network (anonymous, research and non-commercial use, cited): airline departures seen today at LIS, OPO, FAO, FNC by hour and a live snapshot near each airport; counts only, nothing per aircraft. Carris Metropolitana's open alerts and Transtejo Soflusa's own notices, short excerpts with links. The researcher's transport decisions shown from data/decisions/entities/, not copied. Raw captures in a private vault, its key sealed to the conductor through the lane. Not usable from here, listed for the conductor in transport/sources.md: ANA's boards (bot check), OpenSky history (needs an account), Metro's API (needs a key).

0c2a5542e8e13140213dc774910d354ee23e0c1f.body: weather-check allows that one link out (a link, never fetched).

c31fe378594bcbd4c7ec90186fa244cfbd07405c.body:
Phases (nothing stops while the storm is live; a close trigger on IPMA's last
Lisbon warning and the Day 3 decision), a verdict per agent from the record,
the exit interview and its template, the closing record, the storm conductor's
standing newsroom, the order of steps and Dinis's decisions (D1 to D10). Gaps
marked. Public half of the planner's session key in data/keys.json.

95d20395a9e10027a35de4cc7b6053b617d972a9.body:
The decision is the newest dated fact or evidence by websummit in the
decision graph, with its time and the time read, linked to its entry and
the data room; its words are incident.json's headline when the headline
cites the same post. On a phone it is at 402 px (was about 1,590).

4038053e22fc6a26a77bcefbb3330a23c75a3ed2.body:
reporter/traces/*.json (sc-trace/1) are read unchanged: a step's own word is kept as "said",
its verb is the nearest primitive of story/primitives.md, a step with no record is not drawn.
24 flows at /flows/: 3 by recipe, 7 of the storyteller's paths (05, Dinis's 10:10 request,
grows by itself), 14 of the reporter's traces.

bed1fa94893313f4cbd82d9ad7af29641cbc7509.body:
The verbs and kinds of story/primitives.md replace my first list (its words win): wake, read,
write, commit, push, release, publish, capture, hand-over, seal, message, ask, answer, instruct,
route, correct, pause; and the machine kind (CI, a vault, the clock). A step's "before" becomes
its pause's why. Paths 01, 03 and 06 are flows now: /flows/#path-01-a-journalists-wake.

9b6fe987ccf04b243050d277b5398097b6aa7f0b.body:
Storm Charles as a live news channel would show it (Dinis, 11 Nov ~10:13):
a chyron from the headline, a ticker from the newest timeline rows, IPMA's
warnings (Lisbon and every area), an animated wind and pressure map drawn
in the browser from a model field served here (Open-Meteo, CC BY 4.0) over
Natural Earth land, Lisbon airport's METAR, the counts as reported
(evidence), the clock in Lisbon time, a full-screen mode for a television.
Reads only this site's files. Not a warning service. broadcast/README.md
lists the pictures and outside requests for Dinis. Session key's public
half added to data/keys.json.

b144acec5fd59d2f3542cc69654f1d4e82cc66ce.body:
The format: data/flows/schema.json (flows/v1). The builder: tools/flows-build.mjs, a generator
(after; reads tracked files only: data/ci/commits, data/agents/commits.json and sessions.json,
data/keys.json, agents/*/status.json, story/paths/*.md). The player: a light SVG player of our
own (app/flows/player.js), every step with its evidence, embeddable by one line; the browser
API: app/flows/embed.html?kind=&agent=. Experiments, labelled. The session key's public half
in data/keys.json.
